title: Claims claimant-safe projection, ownership, routing roles, status reason and note provenance
story: Fix SEC2-004 (high) and claims mediums SEC2-008 and SEC2-016; remove carrier_admin from routing
acceptance: claimant and agent GET /claims/{id} and POST responses contain no triage.fraudScore, severityScore, flags (SIU), internal notes, reserve suggestions or routing.adjusterId; staff view unchanged
a claimant token cannot read a claim whose reportedBy.id differs (404)
claim.status.changed event and claim_status_history.reason carry no free text (reason code or encrypted); test asserts the outbox payload
POST notes ignores req.body.ai; aiGenerated only set via an internal AI path; test
carrier_admin removed from POST /claims/{claimId}/routing in rules routes (supervisor and adjuster only); route test asserts 403 for carrier_admin
existing claims tests still pass; result states SEC2-004/008/016 todos can be flipped
brief: Files: src/modules/claims/routes.mjs, service.mjs (present at ~84-91, triage/routing written ~494-503, changeStatus ~268-278, addNote ~342-347), src/modules/rules/routes.js (WRITE constant line 3 includes carrier_admin; routes.mjs does not exist yet, edit only routes.js unless it appears). (1) SEC2-004: add a pure function projectForClaimant(claim) in a new src/modules/claims/projection.mjs: whitelist claim number, status, dates, lob, lossType, public documents, redacted party summary; strip triage (fraud indicators, SIU flags, severityScore), routing, notes, reserve suggestions, assignee. Apply in routes.mjs to every response where the caller has no staff role (claimant and agent; PII_ROLES/READ staff keep the full view; auditor and integration unchanged). Whitelist, not blacklist, so new fields default hidden. Also in the service getClaim path for non-staff roles. (2) R5 ownership: for claimant tokens require claim.reportedBy.id === req.user.sub else 404 (no claimIds claim exists; do not change core). (3) SEC2-008: in changeStatus drop reason from the published event (send reasonCode only) and encrypt reason in claim_status_history using the existing pii.mjs helpers; keep reason visible to staff via the API. (4) SEC2-016: in routes.mjs addNote strip ai from req.body; service accepts ai only via an internal option not reachable from HTTP. (5) Rules routes: remove carrier_admin from the routing POST roles. Do not change OVERRIDE_ROLES semantics beyond this. Tests: tests/unit/claims/projection.test.mjs using helpers.mjs with local fakes; do not edit tests/security. Pitfalls: ETag/version must remain; never log PII. After finishing, post to the security hub that SEC2-004, SEC2-008, SEC2-016 todos can be flipped.
valueDrivers: Security: SIU confidentiality and fraud-score secrecy
Privacy: no free-text PII in events

verdicts.reason: All 5 criteria met; claims 36/36 and rules 52/52 pass. Follow-up for architecture: openapi.yaml POST /claims/{id}/routing x-roles still lists carrier_admin, so security/roles.test fails that route until the contract is updated.
